name: Barbarian Guides — "snow landwalk of the chosen type" asks for the land type
notes: "Choose a land type. Target creature you control gains snow landwalk of the chosen type until end of turn." produced no effect and no target picker (audit: no-targeted-effect). The fired ability now carries the land-type input; once a type is chosen the text reads "gains snow forestwalk", which the landwalk catch-all grants to the target (it now accepts a snow / nonbasic prefix).
